title: Arithmetic from nothing but functions
caption: Church's lambda calculus has only functions and function application, yet numbers and addition can be built from them. Each step replaces a name by its definition or applies a function to its argument. Try (\x.x x)(\x.x x): it never finishes, which is the kind of question Church showed no general method can settle.
hint: Try ADD 2 3, MUL 2 3 or SUCC (SUCC 0). Type \ for λ.
